description: A reviewed subset of the Level 1 recommendations that the Mattrax Windows policy catalogue can express. Controls that have no reliable catalogue mapping stay listed as unmapped. This is not a reproduction of the benchmark; see the CIS document for the authoritative text.

controls.title: Password history
controls.description: Require users to cycle through 24 previously used passwords before one can be reused.

controls.title: Maximum password age
controls.description: Expire passwords after a year so a leaked password cannot stay valid indefinitely.

controls.title: Minimum password age
controls.description: Prevent users from changing a password repeatedly in one day to defeat history.

controls.title: Minimum password length
controls.description: Require at least 14 characters for local account passwords.

controls.title: Password complexity
controls.description: Require the Windows complexity rules for local account passwords.

controls.title: Long password support
controls.description: Allow passwords longer than the legacy limit, so passphrases are practical.

controls.title: Reversible password storage
controls.description: Keep passwords out of the reversibly encrypted store.

controls.title: Account lockout duration
controls.description: Keep a locked account locked long enough to slow down guessing.
controls.note: The catalogue exposes lockout duration, threshold and reset time as one ADMX string. Mattrax does not model that serialisation yet.

controls.title: Account lockout threshold
controls.description: Lock an account after a small number of failed sign-ins.
controls.note: The catalogue exposes lockout duration, threshold and reset time as one ADMX string. Mattrax does not model that serialisation yet.

controls.title: Administrator account lockout
controls.description: Apply the lockout policy to the built-in Administrator account too.

controls.title: Lockout counter reset
controls.description: Wait long enough before clearing the failed sign-in counter.
controls.note: The catalogue exposes lockout duration, threshold and reset time as one ADMX string. Mattrax does not model that serialisation yet.

controls.title: Credential Manager caller right
controls.description: Restrict which accounts may act as a trusted caller of Credential Manager.
controls.note: User-right assignment is not exposed as a policy setting in the current catalogue.

controls.title: Local sign-in right
controls.description: Limit the accounts that may sign in at the console.
controls.note: User-right assignment is not exposed as a policy setting in the current catalogue.

controls.title: Deny network sign-in
controls.description: Stop guest and local accounts from signing in over the network.
controls.note: User-right assignment is not exposed as a policy setting in the current catalogue.

controls.title: Block Microsoft accounts
controls.description: Stop users adding Microsoft accounts and stop those accounts signing in.

controls.title: Guest account
controls.description: Keep the built-in guest account disabled.

controls.title: Blank passwords
controls.description: Only allow accounts with blank passwords to sign in at the console.

settings.settingName: Accounts Limit Local Account Use Of Blank Passwords To Console Logon Only

controls.title: Administrator account name
controls.description: Rename the built-in Administrator account.
controls.note: The replacement name is tenant-specific, so the template cannot choose it.

controls.title: Guest account name
controls.description: Rename the built-in guest account.
controls.note: The replacement name is tenant-specific, so the template cannot choose it.

controls.title: Audit subcategory override
controls.description: Let subcategory audit settings override the legacy category settings.

settings.settingName: Audit Force Audit Policy Subcategory Settings To Override Audit Policy Category Settings

controls.title: Shut down when auditing fails
controls.description: Keep the machine running when the security log cannot record events, so an outage does not become a denial of service.

settings.settingName: Audit Shutdown System Immediately If Unable To Log Security Audits

controls.title: Secure channel encryption and signing
controls.description: Always encrypt and sign domain secure-channel traffic.

settings.settingName: Domain Member Digitally Encrypt Or Sign Secure Channel Data Always

controls.title: Secure channel encryption
controls.description: Encrypt domain secure-channel traffic when the peer supports it.

settings.settingName: Domain Member Digitally Encrypt Secure Channel Data When Possible

controls.title: Secure channel signing
controls.description: Sign domain secure-channel traffic when the peer supports it.

settings.settingName: Domain Member Digitally Sign Secure Channel Data When Possible

controls.title: Machine account password changes
controls.description: Keep machine account password rotation enabled.

settings.settingName: Domain Member Disable Machine Account Password Changes

controls.title: Machine account password age
controls.description: Rotate the machine account password at least every 30 days.

settings.settingName: Domain Member Maximum Machine Account Password Age

controls.title: Strong session keys
controls.description: Require a strong session key for domain member traffic.

settings.settingName: Domain Member Require Strong Session Key

controls.title: Ctrl+Alt+Del sign-in
controls.description: Require the secure attention sequence before sign-in.

settings.settingName: Interactive Logon Do Not Require CTRLALTDEL

controls.title: Last signed-in user
controls.description: Do not show the previous user name on the sign-in screen.

settings.settingName: Interactive Logon Do Not Display Last Signed In

controls.title: Machine inactivity limit
controls.description: Lock an idle machine after 15 minutes.
controls.note: The catalogue exposes this key twice: first as a 0/1 enable toggle, then as the numeric timeout. The designer cannot address the numeric form separately.

controls.title: Sign-in message text
controls.description: Show an authorised-use message before sign-in.
controls.note: The message is organisation-specific, so the template cannot choose its wording.

controls.title: Sign-in message title
controls.description: Show a title above the authorised-use message.
controls.note: The message is organisation-specific, so the template cannot choose its wording.

controls.title: Password expiry warning
controls.description: Warn users 14 days before their password expires.

settings.settingName: Interactive Logon Prompt User To Change Password Before Expiration

controls.title: Smart card removal
controls.description: Lock the workstation when a smart card is removed.

settings.settingName: Interactive Logon Smart Card Removal Behavior

controls.title: SMB client signing
controls.description: Always sign SMB client traffic.

settings.settingName: Microsoft Network Client Digitally Sign Communications Always

controls.title: SMB client signing when supported
controls.description: Sign SMB client traffic when the server agrees.

settings.settingName: Microsoft Network Client Digitally Sign Communications If Server Agrees

controls.title: Unencrypted SMB passwords
controls.description: Never send plaintext passwords to third-party SMB servers.

settings.settingName: Microsoft Network Client Send Unencrypted Password To Third Party SMB Servers

controls.title: SMB session idle timeout
controls.description: Disconnect idle SMB sessions after 15 minutes.

settings.settingName: Microsoft Network Server Amount Of Idle Time Required Before Suspending Session

controls.title: SMB server signing
controls.description: Always sign SMB server traffic.

settings.settingName: Microsoft Network Server Digitally Sign Communications Always

controls.title: SMB server signing when supported
controls.description: Sign SMB server traffic when the client agrees.

settings.settingName: Microsoft Network Server Digitally Sign Communications If Client Agrees

controls.title: Disconnect expired sessions
controls.description: Disconnect clients when their logon hours expire.

settings.settingName: Microsoft Network Server Disconnect Clients When Logon Hours Expire

controls.title: Server SPN validation
controls.description: Validate the service principal name a client supplies.

settings.settingName: Microsoft Network Server Server SPN Target Name Validation Level

controls.title: Anonymous SID/name translation
controls.description: Stop anonymous callers translating account names to SIDs.

settings.settingName: Network Access Allow Anonymous SID Or Name Translation

controls.title: Anonymous SAM accounts
controls.description: Stop anonymous enumeration of SAM accounts.

settings.settingName: Network Access Do Not Allow Anonymous Enumeration Of SAM Accounts

controls.title: Anonymous SAM accounts and shares
controls.description: Stop anonymous enumeration of SAM accounts and shares.

settings.settingName: Network Access Do Not Allow Anonymous Enumeration Of Sam Accounts And Shares

controls.title: Stored network credentials
controls.description: Stop Windows storing passwords and credentials for network authentication.

settings.settingName: Network Access Do Not Allow Storage Of Passwords And Credentials For Network Authentication

controls.title: Anonymous Everyone permissions
controls.description: Stop the Everyone group applying to anonymous users.

settings.settingName: Network Access Let Everyone Permissions Apply To Anonymous Users

controls.title: Anonymous named pipes
controls.description: Expose no named pipes to anonymous callers.

settings.settingName: Network Access Named Pipes That Can Be Accessed Anonymously

controls.title: Anonymous registry paths
controls.description: Expose no registry paths to anonymous callers.

settings.settingName: Network Access Remotely Accessible Registry Paths

controls.title: Anonymous registry subpaths
controls.description: Expose no registry subpaths to anonymous callers.

settings.settingName: Network Access Remotely Accessible Registry Paths And Subpaths

controls.title: Anonymous named pipe access
controls.description: Restrict anonymous access to named pipes and shares.

settings.settingName: Network Access Restrict Anonymous Access To Named Pipes And Shares

controls.title: Remote SAM callers
controls.description: Restrict which accounts may query SAM remotely.

settings.settingName: Network Access Restrict Clients Allowed To Make Remote Calls To SAM

controls.title: Anonymous share access
controls.description: Expose no shares to anonymous callers.

settings.settingName: Network Access Shares That Can Be Accessed Anonymously

controls.title: Local account sharing model
controls.description: Make local accounts authenticate as themselves for network access.

settings.settingName: Network Access Sharing And Security Model For Local Accounts

controls.title: NTLM computer identity
controls.description: Let Local System use the computer identity for NTLM.

settings.settingName: Network Security Allow Local System To Use Computer Identity For NTLM

controls.title: NTLM NULL session fallback
controls.description: Disable the LocalSystem NULL session fallback.

settings.settingName: Network Security Allow Local System NULL Session Fallback

controls.title: PKU2U online identities
controls.description: Reject PKU2U authentication using online identities.

settings.settingName: Network Security Allow PKU2U Authentication Requests

controls.title: Kerberos encryption types
controls.description: Limit Kerberos to AES and future encryption types.
controls.note: The catalogue exposes this setting as an ADMX bitmask without a typed field for each encryption suite.

controls.title: LAN Manager password hash
controls.description: Discard the LAN Manager hash when the password next changes.

settings.settingName: Network Security Do Not Store LAN Manager Hash Value On Next Password Change

controls.title: Logoff when hours expire
controls.description: Force a logoff when a user's permitted hours end.

settings.settingName: Network Security Force Logoff When Logon Hours Expire

controls.title: LAN Manager authentication level
controls.description: Send NTLMv2 responses only and refuse LAN Manager and NTLM.

settings.settingName: Network Security LAN Manager Authentication Level

controls.title: LDAP client signing
controls.description: Require LDAP clients to sign their requests.

settings.settingName: Network Security LDAP Client Signing Requirements

controls.title: NTLM session security for clients
controls.description: Require NTLMv2 and 128-bit encryption for NTLM clients.

settings.settingName: Network Security Minimum Session Security For NTLMSSP Based Clients

controls.title: NTLM session security for servers
controls.description: Require NTLMv2 and 128-bit encryption for NTLM servers.

settings.settingName: Network Security Minimum Session Security For NTLMSSP Based Servers

controls.title: NTLM audit traffic
controls.description: Audit incoming NTLM traffic.

settings.settingName: Network Security Restrict NTLM Audit Incoming NTLM Traffic

controls.title: Outgoing NTLM traffic
controls.description: Audit outgoing NTLM traffic to remote servers.
controls.note: The catalogue offers allow or deny, not an audit-only state. The mapping denies all outgoing NTLM, which is stricter than the benchmark and may affect legacy servers.

settings.settingName: Network Security Restrict NTLM Outgoing NTLM Traffic To Remote Servers

controls.title: Case-insensitive subsystems
controls.description: Keep case-insensitivity for non-Windows subsystems.

settings.settingName: System Objects Require Case Insensitivity For Non Windows Subsystems

controls.title: Internal system object permissions
controls.description: Strengthen the default permissions on internal system objects.

settings.settingName: System Objects Strengthen Default Permissions Of Internal System Objects

controls.title: Built-in Administrator UAC
controls.description: Run the built-in Administrator account in Admin Approval Mode.

settings.settingName: User Account Control Use Admin Approval Mode

controls.title: Administrator elevation prompt
controls.description: Prompt administrators for consent on the secure desktop.

settings.settingName: User Account Control Behavior Of The Elevation Prompt For Administrators

controls.title: Standard user elevation prompt
controls.description: Deny elevation requests from standard users automatically.

settings.settingName: User Account Control Behavior Of The Elevation Prompt For Standard Users

controls.title: Detect installer elevation
controls.description: Detect application installers and prompt for elevation.

settings.settingName: User Account Control Detect Application Installations And Prompt For Elevation

controls.title: UIAccess secure locations
controls.description: Only elevate UIAccess applications installed in secure locations.

settings.settingName: User Account Control Only Elevate UI Access Applications That Are Installed In Secure Locations

controls.title: Admin Approval Mode
controls.description: Run every administrator in Admin Approval Mode.

settings.settingName: User Account Control Run All Administrators In Admin Approval Mode

controls.title: Secure desktop prompts
controls.description: Switch to the secure desktop for elevation prompts.

settings.settingName: User Account Control Switch To The Secure Desktop When Prompting For Elevation

controls.title: Virtualise write failures
controls.description: Redirect per-user file and registry write failures to the user profile.

settings.settingName: User Account Control Virtualize File And Registry Write Failures To Per User Locations

controls.title: Domain firewall
controls.description: Turn on Windows Firewall for the domain profile.

controls.title: Domain inbound connections
controls.description: Block unsolicited inbound traffic on the domain profile.

settings.settingName: Default Inbound Action for Domain Profile

controls.title: Domain firewall notifications
controls.description: Stop Windows showing inbound-blocked notifications on the domain profile.

controls.title: Domain firewall log file
controls.description: Write the domain firewall log to the standard System32 location.

controls.title: Domain firewall log size
controls.description: Allow at least 16 MB for the domain firewall log.

controls.title: Domain firewall dropped packets
controls.description: Log dropped packets on the domain profile.

controls.title: Domain firewall successful connections
controls.description: Log successful connections on the domain profile.

controls.title: Private firewall
controls.description: Turn on Windows Firewall for the private profile.

controls.title: Private inbound connections
controls.description: Block unsolicited inbound traffic on the private profile.

settings.settingName: Default Inbound Action for Private Profile

controls.title: Private firewall notifications
controls.description: Stop Windows showing inbound-blocked notifications on the private profile.

controls.title: Private firewall log file
controls.description: Write the private firewall log to the standard System32 location.

controls.title: Private firewall log size
controls.description: Allow at least 16 MB for the private firewall log.

controls.title: Private firewall dropped packets
controls.description: Log dropped packets on the private profile.

controls.title: Private firewall successful connections
controls.description: Log successful connections on the private profile.

controls.title: Public firewall
controls.description: Turn on Windows Firewall for the public profile.

controls.title: Public inbound connections
controls.description: Block unsolicited inbound traffic on the public profile.

settings.settingName: Default Inbound Action for Public Profile

controls.title: Public firewall notifications
controls.description: Stop Windows showing inbound-blocked notifications on the public profile.

controls.title: Public local firewall rules
controls.description: Ignore locally defined firewall rules on the public profile.

controls.title: Public local connection rules
controls.description: Ignore locally defined connection security rules on the public profile.

controls.title: Public firewall log file
controls.description: Write the public firewall log to the standard System32 location.

controls.title: Public firewall log size
controls.description: Allow at least 16 MB for the public firewall log.

controls.title: Public firewall dropped packets
controls.description: Log dropped packets on the public profile.

controls.title: Public firewall successful connections
controls.description: Log successful connections on the public profile.

controls.title: Lock screen camera
controls.description: Stop users enabling the camera from the lock screen.

controls.title: Lock screen slideshow
controls.description: Stop users enabling a slideshow on the lock screen.

settings.settingName: Prevent enabling lock screen slide show

controls.title: Online speech recognition
controls.description: Disable online speech recognition.

controls.title: UAC for local accounts
controls.description: Apply UAC restrictions to local accounts on network logons.

settings.settingName: Apply UAC restrictions to local accounts on network logons

controls.title: SMBv1 client driver
controls.description: Disable the SMBv1 client driver.

controls.title: SMBv1 server
controls.description: Disable server-side SMBv1 processing.

controls.title: SEHOP
controls.description: Enable Structured Exception Handling Overwrite Protection.

settings.settingName: Enable Structured Exception Handling Overwrite Protection (SEHOP)

controls.title: NetBIOS node type
controls.description: Use point-to-point NetBIOS name resolution.

controls.title: WDigest authentication
controls.description: Stop WDigest retaining plaintext credentials in memory.

controls.title: Automatic sign-in
controls.description: Disable automatic sign-in at boot.

controls.title: ICMP redirects
controls.description: Stop ICMP redirects overriding OSPF routes.

settings.settingName: MSS: (EnableICMPRedirect) Allow ICMP redirects to override OSPF generated routes

controls.title: NetBIOS name release
controls.description: Ignore NetBIOS name release requests except from WINS servers.

settings.settingName: MSS: (NoNameReleaseOnDemand) Allow the computer to ignore NetBIOS name release requests except from WINS servers

controls.title: Safe DLL search mode
controls.description: Enable the safe DLL search order.

settings.settingName: MSS: (SafeDllSearchMode) Enable Safe DLL search mode (recommended)

controls.title: Screen saver grace period
controls.description: Use a screen saver grace period of five seconds or less.
controls.note: The catalogue exposes the numeric grace period behind an enable toggle that the designer resolves first, so the value cannot be set safely.

controls.title: Security log warning level
controls.description: Warn when the security log reaches 90% capacity.
controls.note: The catalogue exposes the numeric warning level behind an enable toggle that the designer resolves first, so the value cannot be set safely.

controls.title: Multicast name resolution
controls.description: Turn off multicast name resolution.

controls.title: Virtualisation-based security
controls.description: Turn on virtualisation-based security.

controls.title: VBS platform security
controls.description: Require Secure Boot for virtualisation-based security.

controls.title: Hypervisor code integrity
controls.description: Enable hypervisor-protected code integrity with UEFI lock.

controls.title: UEFI memory attributes
controls.description: Require the UEFI memory attributes table.

controls.title: Credential Guard
controls.description: Enable Credential Guard with UEFI lock.

controls.title: Secure Launch
controls.description: Enable Secure Launch when the hardware supports it.

controls.title: Offer Remote Assistance
controls.description: Disable unsolicited Remote Assistance offers.

controls.title: Solicited Remote Assistance
controls.description: Disable solicited Remote Assistance.

controls.title: Non-volume autoplay
controls.description: Disallow AutoPlay for MTP devices such as cameras and phones.

controls.title: AutoRun default
controls.description: Do not execute AutoRun commands.

controls.title: AutoPlay
controls.description: Turn off AutoPlay.

controls.title: Consumer account content
controls.description: Turn off cloud consumer account state content.

controls.title: Consumer experiences
controls.description: Turn off Microsoft consumer experiences.

controls.title: Password reveal button
controls.description: Do not show the password reveal button.

settings.settingName: Do not display the password reveal button

controls.title: Administrator enumeration
controls.description: Do not enumerate administrator accounts on elevation.

controls.title: Security questions
controls.description: Prevent local accounts using security questions for password reset.

settings.settingName: Prevent the use of security questions for local accounts

controls.title: Diagnostic data
controls.description: Send no optional diagnostic data.

controls.title: Feedback notifications
controls.description: Do not show feedback notifications.

controls.title: App Installer
controls.description: Disable the App Installer.

controls.title: App Installer experiments
controls.description: Disable App Installer experimental features.

controls.title: App Installer hash override
controls.description: Disable the App Installer hash override.

controls.title: App Installer protocol
controls.description: Disable the ms-appinstaller protocol.

controls.title: Network protection
controls.description: Block dangerous websites with Defender network protection.

controls.title: File hash computation
controls.description: Enable Defender file hash computation.

controls.title: Downloaded file scanning
controls.description: Scan all downloaded files and attachments.

settings.settingName: Allow scanning of all downloaded files and attachments

controls.title: Real-time protection
controls.description: Keep Defender real-time protection on.

controls.title: Behaviour monitoring
controls.description: Turn on Defender behaviour monitoring.

controls.title: Script scanning
controls.description: Turn on Defender script scanning.

controls.title: Removable drive scanning
controls.description: Scan removable drives during full scans.

settings.settingName: Allow Full Scan Removable Drive Scanning

controls.title: Email scanning
controls.description: Turn on Defender email scanning.

controls.title: Potentially unwanted applications
controls.description: Block potentially unwanted applications.

controls.title: Defender antivirus
controls.description: Keep Microsoft Defender Antivirus enabled.

controls.title: OneDrive file storage
controls.description: Prevent OneDrive being used for file storage.
controls.note: The catalogue's OneDrive collection does not expose the tenant-wide disable switch this recommendation needs.

controls.title: Drive redirection
controls.description: Do not allow drive redirection in Remote Desktop sessions.
controls.note: The catalogue does not expose the drive-redirection setting.

controls.title: RDP password prompt
controls.description: Always prompt for a password when a Remote Desktop connection is made.

settings.settingName: Always prompt for password upon connection

controls.title: RDP secure RPC
controls.description: Require secure RPC for Remote Desktop.

controls.title: RDP security layer
controls.description: Require SSL for Remote Desktop connections.
controls.note: The catalogue's first entry for the shared OMA-URI exposes only Enabled/Disabled, not the SSL level.

controls.title: RDP network level authentication
controls.description: Require Network Level Authentication for Remote Desktop.

settings.settingName: Require user authentication for remote connections by using Network Level Authentication

controls.title: RDP encryption level
controls.description: Require high-level encryption for Remote Desktop.

controls.title: Cortana
controls.description: Disable Cortana.

controls.title: Cortana above lock
controls.description: Disable Cortana on the lock screen.

controls.title: Widgets
controls.description: Disable Windows widgets.

controls.title: Phishing data collection
controls.description: Enable automatic data collection for enhanced phishing protection.

controls.title: Malicious password warning

controls.title: Password reuse warning
controls.description: Warn users when they reuse a password.

controls.title: Unsafe app warning
controls.description: Warn users before they use an unsafe application.

controls.title: Phishing protection service
controls.description: Enable the enhanced phishing protection service.

controls.title: SmartScreen
controls.description: Enable Windows Defender SmartScreen.

controls.title: MSI user control

settings.settingName: MSI Allow User Control Over Install

controls.title: MSI elevated installs

settings.settingName: MSI Always Install With Elevated Privileges

controls.title: WinRM client basic auth

controls.description: Disable unencrypted WinRM client traffic.

controls.description: Disable unencrypted WinRM service traffic.

controls.title: WinRM RunAs credentials

settings.settingName: Disallow WinRM from storing RunAs credentials

controls.title: Windows Sandbox clipboard

controls.title: Windows Sandbox networking
controls.description: Disable networking in Windows Sandbox.

controls.title: Automatic updates
controls.description: Configure Windows Update to download and schedule installs automatically.

controls.title: Pause updates

controls.title: Preview builds
controls.description: Disable preview build enrolment.

controls.title: Feature update deferral

settings.settingName: Defer Feature Updates Period In Days

controls.title: Attachment zone information
controls.description: Preserve zone information on file attachments.

controls.title: Attachment antivirus notification
controls.description: Notify antivirus programs when attachments are opened.
controls.note: User-scoped Windows setting. The policy designer saves device-scoped configurations, so add this through the policy editor with user scope.

controls.title: Lock screen spotlight

controls.title: Spotlight third-party suggestions
